# `/identity-profiles` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /identity-profiles/v1

`listIdentityProfilesV1` — List identity profiles

Get a list of identity profiles, based on the specified query parameters.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, ne, ge, gt, in, le, sw; name: eq, ne, ge, gt, in, le, sw; priority: eq, ne — e.g. `id eq "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, priority, created, modified, owner.id, owner.name — e.g. `id,name`
- Returns 200: array of identityprofile

### POST /identity-profiles/v1

`createIdentityProfileV1` — Create identity profile

Creates an identity profile.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Body (application/json): identityprofile
- Returns 201: identityprofile

### POST /identity-profiles/v1/bulk-delete

`deleteIdentityProfilesV1` — Delete identity profiles

This deletes multiple Identity Profiles via a list of supplied IDs. On success, this endpoint will return a reference to the bulk delete task result. The following rights are required to access this endpoint: idn:identity-profile:delete

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Body (application/json): array of string
- Returns 202: taskresultsimplified

  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, ne; name: eq, ne; priority: eq, ne — e.g. `id eq "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"`

### POST /identity-profiles/v1/import

`importIdentityProfilesV1` — Import identity profiles

This imports previously exported identity profiles.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Body (application/json): array of identityprofileexportedobject
- Returns 200: objectimportresult

### GET /identity-profiles/v1/{identity-profile-id}

`getIdentityProfileV1` — Get identity profile

Get a single identity profile by ID.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `identity-profile-id` (path, required) — Identity profile ID.
- Returns 200: identityprofile

### DELETE /identity-profiles/v1/{identity-profile-id}

`deleteIdentityProfileV1` — Delete identity profile

Delete an identity profile by ID. On success, this endpoint will return a reference to the bulk delete task result.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `identity-profile-id` (path, required) — Identity profile ID.
- Returns 202: taskresultsimplified

### PATCH /identity-profiles/v1/{identity-profile-id}

`updateIdentityProfileV1` — Update identity profile

Update a specified identity profile with this PATCH request. You cannot update these fields: * id * created * modified * identityCount * identityRefreshRequired * Authoritative Source and Identity Attribute Configuration cannot be modified at the same time.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `identity-profile-id` (path, required) — Identity profile ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: identityprofile

### GET /identity-profiles/v1/{identity-profile-id}/default-identity-attribute-config

`getDefaultIdentityAttributeConfigV1` — Get default identity attribute config

This returns the default identity attribute config.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `identity-profile-id` (path, required) — The Identity Profile ID.
- Returns 200: identityattributeconfig

### POST /identity-profiles/v1/{identity-profile-id}/process-identities

`syncIdentityProfileV1` — Process identities under profile

Process identities under the profile This operation should not be used to schedule your own identity processing or to perform system wide identity refreshes. The system will use a combination of [event-based processing](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/saas/help/setup/identity_processing.html?h=process#event-based-processing) and [scheduled processing](https://documentation.sailpoint.com/saas/help/setup/identity_processing.html?h=process#scheduled-processing) that runs every day at 8:00 AM…

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Parameters:
  - `identity-profile-id` (path, required) — The Identity Profile ID to be processed
- Returns 202: object

### POST /identity-profiles/v1/identity-preview

`generateIdentityPreviewV1` — Generate identity profile preview

This generates a non-persisted IdentityDetails object that will represent as the preview of the identities attribute when the given policy''s attribute config is applied.

- Scopes: idn:identity-profile:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, API
- Body (application/json): identitypreviewrequest
- Returns 200: identitypreviewresponse

### POST /identity-profiles/v1/{identity-profile-id}/lifecycle-states

`createLifecycleStateV1` — Create lifecycle state

`updateLifecycleStatesV1` — Update lifecycle state
